_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Uwewe ni Umukinozi {player_id} mu mukino wa Liar's Dice wa {num_players}-player.
Amateka:
- Ku mukino wawe,
  1) Utanga ikintu gishya na kurenga au gito cy'umwihariko (cyangwa byose) na ikintu gishya; kwa manza '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Uvuge ikintu gishya kwa kutumira '[Call]'.

Iki uvuga:
  - Iki ibiro vy'umwihariko vya face vyose vya chini vya bid, umutangazii wa nyuma ashyirwa imiringa.
  - Iki vyose si vya chini, umuvugizi ashyirwa imiringa.
Umukinozi utararika imiringa itatu atashyirwa. Umukinozi mw'indashyikirwa atsinze.

board.new_round:
New round - Remaining dice: {dice_summary}
Your current Dice are: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Umukinozi {current_player_id} aravuga! Ibiro vy'umwihariko vya face {face_value} ni {count}, vyose vya chini {quantity}.
Umukinozi {loser_id} (umutangazii wa nyuma) ashyirwa imiringa.
call.caller_loses:
Umukinozi {current_player_id} aravuga! Ibiro vy'umwihariko vya face {face_value} ni {count}, vyose vya kurenga {quantity}.
Umukinozi {loser_id} (umuvugizi) ashyirwa imiringa.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Call made with no prior bid.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action not recognized as either a valid '[Bid: X, Y]' or '[Call]'. Submitted action: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Ubwoko bushya {new_quantity} ni bugufi kuva na bushya {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Agaciro gashya k'amazina {new_face_value} ni gato ugereranyije n'aka kanya {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Igitekerezo cyo gutanga ni kimwe n'icyo ubu batanga.
bid_reason.face_range: Agaciro kacyo kagomba kuba kari hagati ya 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Umukinnyi {player_id} yarangije gukina kubera ko yari afite umukino utagira agaciro.
